Context: 21. Ex gratia Pension/Family Pension to CPF Retirees

Dearness Relief al the foHowing rates will be admissible on the amount of ex gratia pension/family perasion:-  
From l-4-1004., Dearness Relief equal to 50% of ex gratia is treated as Dearness ex gratia and Dearness Relief is to be-calculated on (ex gratia plus Dearness ex gratia).
